name: Platformer
description: The precision-traversal baseline: jump, avoid, collect, reach the goal. The pack assumes the existing movement kit (jump, dash, wall, ledge, ground sensing) and adds the level furniture a platformer cannot ship without — carriers, springs, checkpoints, and the collectible economy that paces a stage. Coyote time and jump buffering are intentionally absent from the new list: movement.jump_core already owns both, and this pack treats that as settled.

signatureCompound.name: One Clean Stage
signatureCompound.description: A single level that proves the loop: jump across moving platforms, spring to a high route, collect the scatter along the intended arc, die once to a hazard and respawn at the checkpoint, then touch the goal. Every new component in the pack is load-bearing in this compound.
